title: Broadcast
description: A /broadcast system that sends a big broadcast to all players on your Minecraft server.
body:
This plugin lets you do **/broadcast <message>** to broadcast a big message to all players on your server. This plugin supports color codes e.g. &6 Hello World! and hex color codes.

To use it you have to have **Operator** permission or on LuckPerms you need to have **broadcast.use** otherwise you cannot run the command. To reload the plugin after configurating in **config.yml** you need **Operator** permission or **broadcast.reload**.

There is a **config.yml** file where you can customize how your Broadcast looks and what sound it plays when you run the command.

If you find any bugs join the Discord server and ping @stickyballs2652 or create a ticket!
